question.text: A Large Value Fund (LVF) classified as a Category III AIF enjoys a relaxed concentration limit for single investee company, which is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 10.1.4.1: SEBI relaxes the Cat III single-investee concentration limit to 20% of Investable Funds or NAV for LVFs, versus 10% for regular Cat III. Per the current source, an LVF requires a minimum commitment of not less than INR 25 crore per eligible investor. The Trap: Option A (10%) is the regular Cat III limit. Options B (15%) and D (25%) are fabricated thresholds. Note: The 20% LVF relaxation applies only when the fund qualifies as a Large Value Fund under SEBI AIF rules; regular Cat III remains capped at 10%.
